observations: A round yellow head with dark headphones and X-marked sunglasses sits atop a white T-shirt printed with the text 'NIFTY INK'; arms extend wide against a flat teal background.
The word 'WAGMI' appears three times in loose hand-drawn lettering across the upper field, alongside small music-note symbols and white wavy lines that spread outward from the figure.

A thick horizontal yellow bar crosses the lower third of the image, and a single yellow vertical stroke descends from the figure's torso toward the bottom edge, leaving the figure's feet clear of the ground.
reading: The figure's arms flung wide and feet lifted give the pose a suspended, buoyant quality. White wavy lines and scattered music-note marks fill the teal field, reading as sound made visible. The repeated 'WAGMI' text acts as both caption and pattern, its loose lettering matching the surrounding marks. Yellow head and limbs against the flat ground keep the figure legible while everything around it stays loose and open.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnxyz-other subset, this work sits between recorded-creation neighbors 'nnxyz nifty summer night ink' and 'nnxyz 300 nifties.' The same flat teal ground and yellow-dominant figure recur in owned nnotb works, marking a consistent color pairing across the collection.
